name: web-ps103
about: Psalm 103:1-5: a superscription without §, ¶▼ poetry, /_ indented lines

rows.text: By David.¶▼Praise Yahweh, my soul!/_All that is within me, praise his holy name!
/Praise Yahweh, my soul,/_and don’t forget all his benefits;
/who forgives all your sins;/_who heals all your diseases;
/who redeems your life from destruction;/_who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies;
/who satisfies your desire with good things,/_so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
